::: {.lead}
Assistant Professor in Animal Genetics  
University of Bologna, Italy
:::

My background is in bioinformatics and systems
biology, with experience in computational methods
for molecular interaction networks and omics data
integration.

My research covers different areas of animal
genetics and genomics, from the genetic architecture
of complex traits and pig metabolomics and phenomics
to population genomics, biodiversity and molecular
traceability.

Depending on the research question, I develop
computational methods, integrate omics datasets,
or apply statistical and machine learning
approaches to biological data.

## Research areas

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Animal Genomics & Phenomics

Genetic architecture of complex traits,
genome-wide association studies, pig
metabolomics and molecular phenotypes.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Multi-Omics & Computational Biology

Integration of genomic, metabolomic and
phenotypic data, systems biology and
computational methods.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Biodiversity & Population Genomics

Genetic diversity, population structure,
environmental genomics and biodiversity
monitoring.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Bioinformatics & Machine Learning

Computational workflows, statistical
modelling and machine learning applied
to biological datasets.
:::

:::
